stories.story_fr: Unipol affiche une forte hausse des primes Vie a 2,6 Md€ au T1 2025 (vs 1,9 Md€), principal moteur de croissance, tout en maintenant un ratio combine Non-Vie discipline a 91,0%.
stories.story_en: Unipol posts strong Life premium growth to EUR 2.6 billion in Q1 2025 (vs EUR 1.9 billion), the main growth driver, while keeping a disciplined Non-Life combined ratio at 91.0%.

stories.story_fr: Le ratio de solvabilite Solvency 2 d'Unipol atteint 277% au T1 2025, en nette hausse, offrant une marge de capital tres confortable au-dela des exigences reglementaires.
stories.story_en: Unipol's Solvency 2 ratio reaches 277% in Q1 2025, sharply higher, providing a very comfortable capital buffer above regulatory requirements.
